mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.config_id, b.axis_type, b.x_model_name, b.y_model_name, GROUP_CONCAT( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(b.x_interval_list, CONCAT('$[', n.n, '].text'))) ORDER BY n.n SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS x_interval_list, GROUP_CONCAT( JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(b.y_interval_list, CONCAT('$[', n.n, '].text'))) ORDER BY n.n SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS y_interval_list, b.`order`, b.is_del, b.create_time, b.update_time FROM b_report_interval_model b JOIN tools_numbers n ON 1 = 1 WHERE b.config_id = #{configId} AND n.n < GREATEST (COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(b.x_interval_list), 0), COALESCE(JSON_LENGTH(b.y_interval_list), 0) ) GROUP BY b.id order by b.`order`;
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO b_report_interval_model (config_id, axis_type, x_model_name, y_model_name, x_interval_list, y_interval_list, `order`, is_del, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{item.configId}, #{item.axisType}, #{item.xModelName}, #{item.yModelName}, #{item.xIntervalList}, #{item.yIntervalList}, #{item.order}, #{item.isDel}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.updateTime})
